name: Palworld-Panel-overlay-v0.8.80-to-v0.8.81
verification: Boss package passed isolated Go compilation, selected unit tests and go vet with an offline sqlite import stub
RCON packet framing, authentication, command execution and timeout completion were unit-tested with net.Pipe
PalSummon JSON generation, coordinate output and command construction were unit-tested
Unsafe multiplier execution, invalid filenames, disabled RCON and mismatched PalTemplate identity were unit-tested
Boss API client and BossOperations page passed isolated strict TypeScript typecheck with dependency stubs
Boss frontend sources passed TypeScript syntax transpilation
OpenAPI YAML parsed with exactly 351 operations and unique operationId values
All runtime Boss routes were matched to OpenAPI paths and permissions
Execution ledger schema and restart reconciliation SQL were validated with SQLite
Patch version verified as 0.8.81 in runtime metadata, OpenAPI and generated contracts
UTF-8, LF, final-newline and trailing-whitespace checks
Internal SHA-256 manifest, ZIP integrity and extract-and-verify checks
limitations: The complete repository go test ./... and frontend npm run check were not run in this environment
No live Palworld or PalDefender server was available for an end-to-end RCON summon test
This release executes one pending wave per administrator action and does not automatically honor delay_seconds
Boss death detection, participants, damage attribution, reward settlement, teleport and cleanup remain unimplemented
The execution lock is process-local; running multiple PalPanel processes against the same database is unsupported
